image.note: Sid Meier's Pirates! v1.0.2.0 (build 30927), extracted from the 2004 installer

compiler.name: Visual C++ .NET 2003 (cl 13.10.3077)
compiler.notes: The image's linker version is 7.10 and the Rich header records build 3077, the VC7.1 RTM toolset. The exact per-unit optimization, runtime, RTTI, exception and inline flags are not yet proven; every unit must declare its own flags and justify them by matching bytes. A wrapper script can replace 'wine cl' when the toolchain lives in a Wine prefix. The verified unit below uses absolute /tmp paths from the 2026-11-09 extraction; those paths are ephemeral and must be restaged from findings/2026-11-08-compiler-availability.md.

units.evidence: First real game-function PASS. VC7.1 cl 13.10.3077 /O2 emitted 8b 44 24 04 89 41 0c c2 04 00, identical to the shipped 9 bytes; the 7 trailing 0xCC bytes trim. The explicit __thiscall keyword is rejected by this compiler; a C++ member function supplies the packed thiscall ABI.
Second real game-function PASS. Returning this forces mov eax,ecx; the shipped 9 bytes are 8b c1 8a 4c 24 04 88 48 18 c2 04 00 and /O2 reproduces them exactly.
Third real game-function PASS: 12-byte struct assignment from +0x90 to +0x28 matches the shipped 26-byte body exactly under VC7.1 /O2.
